status: Round 5 · real browser evidence and rendering speed
detail: Draft PR 52 contains the working 3D game. The isolated browser run passes 11 of 12 checks; full-HD frame rate is the remaining failure. Latest character, portrait and matched cache captures are now available for independent review.
latestCaption: Round 5 · cached 3D scene from a frozen real public replay frame, captured in isolated CI

reviews.gap: Larger forward-facing eyes, continuous brow volumes and unified jaw now have a real runtime capture. The previous independent comparison still favored Snake Pass; the new character is under review.

Independent inspection finds the same scene and gameplay objects in direct/cached images. Fine flowers, foliage and stone silhouettes look harder/brighter in the cache; this is recorded as a cosmetic gap. Full-HD frame pacing remains open.
Portrait controls, cameras, lifecycle, reconnect, cache resize and context-loss recovery pass on an isolated runner. The remaining failure is the unchanged full-HD frame-rate gate.

rounds.title: Baseline · flat 2D broadcast
rounds.summary: Recorded the existing running game before the 3D transformation.

rounds.title: First construction · verdant ruins
rounds.summary: Original procedural serpent and rich environment, responsive broadcast shell, safe WebGL fallback and motion handling. Visual review is still open.

rounds.title: Round 2 · scene cleanup and performance
rounds.summary: Quiet weathered stone, deeper background, more visible fruit, correct occupancy and public-friendly intent. Capture exposed a shadow-map quality-switch bug; fixed and tested in the next round.

rounds.title: Round 3 · direct character comparison
rounds.summary: Shadow-map rendering is valid after resizing (GL error 0). Blind A/B reference won; character anatomy and close framing are being rebuilt. Portrait distance fog still needed correction.

rounds.title: Round 4 · continuous skull and portrait framing
rounds.summary: A frozen real public replay frame makes the character and camera evidence reproducible. The reference still wins facial expression. Static world merging improved measured throughput from 2.29 to 3.88 FPS without removing scenery; the performance gate remains open.

rounds.title: Round 5 · character expression and independent browser evidence
rounds.summary: The new face is rendered and the portrait controls no longer overlap. Independent CI passes 11 of 12 checks. Matched cache captures show the same real replay frame; speed at full HD is still below the required gate.

checks: Full repository Node regression: 515 passed, 0 failed/skipped/cancelled on checkpoint 40bc6cc; the repository CI also passed its Node and authority gates.
Isolated real-browser run on c07c412: 11 passed, 1 failed. Cameras, portrait controls, fallback, lifecycle/reconnect, cache resizing and context loss pass.
Full-HD frame-rate gate remains open: 5 frames observed in the one-second measurement, below the unchanged 17 FPS requirement. The next cache optimization is underway.
Matched cache frames show 74,935 → 11,498 steady-frame triangles. Initial-frame timings are not treated as a sustained speed claim.
12 focused presentation/model checks and independent code-review corrections are retained.
The commercial visual benchmark and external production R5 gates remain open.
